dict.string: Upshot records your voice to write your meeting notes.
Upshot listens to other people on your call so the transcript includes everyone.
Upshot uses your contacts to match calendar attendees with names and email addresses saved on your Mac.
Upshot reads your calendar to title meetings and offer to record. It never edits events.
Upshot shows reminders next to your meeting notes.
Upshot connects to local models such as Ollama and LM Studio on your network.
